blocks.text: This Contract Franchise and Ordinance shall take effect on the first day of the month after all of the following events have occurred: (1) approval by the governing body; (2) publication in the official City newspaper; and (3) acceptance by Grantee. (Ord. 20252 § 16, 8-11-20.)
